intro: Catch up on the key A Level ideas. Complete four retrieval questions, work through the examples, then practise and explain your reasoning.

blocks.title: Key vocabulary
items: spiral model — Risk-driven iterative development lifecycle.
risk analysis — Estimating likelihood and impact of potential problems.
prototype — Early model built to explore or test an idea.
iteration — Repeated cycle of development and evaluation.

blocks.title: Plan the cycle
blocks.text: Set objectives, options and constraints for a spiral iteration.

blocks.title: Analyse risks
blocks.text: Evaluate and reduce technical or organisational uncertainties before commitment.

blocks.title: Prototype and review
blocks.text: Develop/verify increment, consult stakeholders, plan next risk-driven cycle.

blocks.title: Worked example · Model answer
blocks.text: Each cycle sets goals, identifies risks such as fraud or performance, prototypes/assesses the riskiest elements, evaluates with stakeholders then plans the next cycle. Risk reduction drives the project. Check: link each claim to the scenario and use precise OCR terminology.
